This resin is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in southern Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

To obtain its properties, it is used by direct application.

Rubbed onto a dying person, this resin can prevent death for several hours.
